inlines.v: CONSOCIATE, noun [Latin See the next word.] An associate; a partner or confederate; an accomplice. CONSOCIATE, verb transitive [Latin , to unite; a companion. See Social.] 1. To unite; to join; to associate. 2. To cement, or hold in close union. 3. To unite in an assembly or convention, as pastors and messengers or delegates of churches. CONSOCIATE, verb intransitive 1. To unite; to coalesce. 2. To unite, or meet in a body; to form a consociation of pastors and messengers.
